item.title: 🔵 Your AI bill is out of control. Cloudflare can fix it now.
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
AI Gateway now features real-time spend limits to prevent runaway token bills across multiple AI providers. By integrating with Cloudflare Access, companies can use identity-driven budgets and policies.

Source: Cloudflare Blog  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 1d ago

item.title: 🔵 VoidZero is joining Cloudflare
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
VoidZero, the team behind Vite, Vitest, Rolldown, Oxc, and Vite+, is joining Cloudflare. Vite stays open source, vendor-agnostic, and built for everyone.

Source: Cloudflare Blog  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 2d ago
